text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
Once I rest a bit, I'll be right back...!
choice_data_list: When you're not feeling well, take it easy and rest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ugh, yes...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Where is this...?
Are you awake?

text_block_list.name: God of Manga
text_block_list.text:
"I am the God of Manga.
I shall grant you, a manga artist, a single wish."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? Then...
Please, go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please duplicate me!
That way, I'll be able to draw way more manga...!

text_block_list.name: Assist Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All done! Keep sending the data over!
I'll handle drawing the backgrounds!

text_block_list.name: Composition Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, about this scene!
Don't you think we could cut down on the inner monologue more?
I feel like the visuals already tell the story~.

text_block_list.name: Original Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! The plot ideas for the next chapter just keep coming! Still not done with the manuscript? Guess I'll just write ahead and stockpile ideas over here~~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing...!
All that work is totally done...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, with this, I can think up the next chapter
while drawing—

text_block_list.name: Original Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's my job!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Original Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? But isn't that right?
You're in charge of drawing and racing. Just focus on that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no... but...
I wanna do other things too...

text_block_list.name: Original Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "No, no, no! Why do you think we split up in the first place?! We're busy, so let's be efficient! Come on, let's give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's... true, but...
Still............—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo sorry!
Forget that wish, take it baaaack!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki and Others
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's that!? You wanna go!?
Rah-rah! Gah-gah!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooooo sorry!!
But I love all of them! I don't wanna give any up!
I wanna make all of them myself~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
☆Flowing tears are born of love--!
With all our passion in hand, forward!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?!
A dream?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait... this urge.
This passion—it's the real deal!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I can do it, I can create it...!
Right now, I can create something truly 'interesting'--!"
